data.text: I’m happy to commit to Luke’s 17-ton limit if all five of us agree. It gives each of us $17,000 now without leaning quite so heavily on a refill that might not happen. Let’s also agree not to reuse that quota automatically: if next month starts at 30 tons, for example, 5 tons each would leave the minimum 5. We can review everyone’s catches afterward and address any overruns without retaliating by emptying the lake. John, can you join us on 17 tons this month?
